name: Fill Blur
description: Fills the empty sides around a video of another shape with a blurred, enlarged copy of itself, as for a vertical phone video in a wide frame.

params.name: aspect
params.description: Width / height of the output (16:9 = 1.778); 0 keeps the size of the clip and shrinks the picture by `scale`

params.name: scale
params.description: Size of the sharp picture inside the frame

params.name: blur
params.description: Blur of the background, as a mip level (each step doubles it)
